posts.title: Sparks Fly for MITverses 2025: MPC Collab#3
posts.description: I collaborated with Yosun on a single about modern interaction with technology. It narrates how two people find happiness through their shared joy in technology, and the promise of online connections and satisfying curiousity… but then it turns out that technology has downsides such as lack of physicality, loss of privacy, and addiction. posts.title: Scientific Method for MITverses 2023: MPC Collab#2
posts.description: I collaborated with MusicAndSong on a song about the love for the scientific method. It narrates how two people find happiness through their shared joy in scientific discovery. This was my track for the MITverses album, MPC Collab#2. Check out the rest of the MPC Collab#2. MITverses album here: SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/mitmpc/sets/mpcollab-vol-2-mit-verses Spotify: https://open.spotify.c
